主要内容: On May 18, 2012, NOVAVAX INC agreed to sell 10,000,000 shares of its common stock, par value $0.01 per share, to one or more affiliates of RA Capital Management, LLC at $1.22 per share. The proceeds to the company, before expenses, will be approximately $12.2 million. Total expenses of this offering are estimated at $100,000. The company is filing legal opinion and consent documents, as well as a press release, as exhibits to this Current Report on Form 8-K.
